families.title: Lady Nana of Panch
families.zh: 潘治的娜娜夫人 · 方孔铜钱
families.description: Square-holed cast bronze with a Sogdian legend and the Panch tamgha. Sources differ in date, face order and the interpretation of Nana. The gallery preserves catalogue groupings and individual specimens.

anchor.role: Attributed city · 归属城市展示锚点

families.question: “Lady Nana”作为人物、头衔或女神的解释仍需结合铭文及研究；不自动套用 Zeno 的 Divashtich 归属。年代采用来源的宽区间，709–722 是常见归属之一。
families.legendNote: CNG 611/576 原文所列不同读法，意译为“潘治的娜娜夫人”。正反面命名因目录而异。

places.name: Panjakent / Panch
places.note: Ancient Penjikent. UNESCO coordinates: 39°29′13″N, 67°37′10″E. Historical context; not a type-specific findspot.

places.name: Samarkand / Afrasiab
places.zh: 撒马尔罕／阿弗拉西阿卜
places.note: Ancient Samarkand. Coordinates are an editorial site anchor, not a mint or excavated coin context.

places.name: Suyab / Ak-Beshim
places.note: Ak-Beshim archaeological site, identified with Suyab. City anchor for exploration of Semirechye; no individual mint attribution asserted.

places.name: Navekat / Krasnaya Rechka
places.note: Krasnaya Rechka archaeological site, associated with Navekat. Cultural context; coin-specific find context remains to be entered.

places.name: Balasagun / Burana
places.note: Burana archaeological site. Later medieval context; not assumed to be an issuing city in every timeline year.

places.name: Taraz
places.note: Historic city in the Talas valley. Orientation point; no type-specific findspot asserted.

places.name: Bukhara
places.note: Historic Bukhara. Orientation point, separate from an issuing or findspot claim.

places.name: Paikend
places.note: Paikend archaeological site in the Bukhara oasis. Exact site geometry and coin assemblages await entry.

places.name: Bunjikat
places.note: Ancient Bunjikat, Shahristan. Coordinates transcribed from the UNESCO tentative-list entry.

places.name: Chach / Tashkent
places.note: Chach regional orientation. This modern-city anchor does not locate a particular ancient mint.

places.name: Balkh
places.note: Ancient Balkh. Orientation for northern Afghanistan; a regional find report is not assigned to this city.

places.name: Kucha / Qiuci
places.note: Kucha attribution in British Museum coin record. Coordinates mark the modern city for orientation, not a documented mint or findspot.

places.name: Kashgar
places.note: Silk Road city for orientation. Historical settlement extent is not reconstructed.

places.name: Khotan
places.note: Khotan oasis orientation point. The exact ancient settlement and mint are separate research questions.
